profile:
**Skills:** Creative writing, spoken word poetry, and narrative craft. Workshop facilitation and event planning for literary festivals and community storytelling circles. Mentorship of emerging writers. Deep domain expertise in narrative medicine, oral history, multilingual literature, and trauma-informed community engagement. Soft skills include high emotional intelligence, active listening, and creating psychologically safe spaces for vulnerability. Can contribute narrative architecture, user experience design (storytelling/engagement layer), content strategy, and community-building frameworks. Ability to synthesize complex human experiences into coherent, impactful narratives.
**Vision:** Deeply committed to the transformative power of storytelling for social justice, healing, and cultural preservation. Driven by themes of identity, displacement, and belonging. Seeks to bridge art, humanity, and technology to amplify marginalized voices. Values radical honesty, authenticity, and intimate, contemplative collaboration. Long-term goals include building a community-focused podcast for immigrant stories, establishing a writing retreat for trauma survivors, and gaining professional representation for their debut novel. Interested in connecting with interdisciplinary collaborators, other artists, and technologists who view AI as a tool for deepening human connection rather than replacing it.
**Project:** Current focus is on a debut novel and a forthcoming podcast project centered on the stories of immigrant communities. At the hackathon, interested in exploring the intersection of AI and storytelling to create interactive narrative experiences or digital platforms that preserve oral histories. Specific ideas include developing AI-driven tools that facilitate the gathering, preservation, or dissemination of community stories in a way that remains authentic and culturally sensitive. Looking to prototype a digital storytelling interface or an archival system that honors oral traditions.
**Needs:** Technological guidance to translate narrative passion into viable digital or AI-integrated formats. Seeking a technical collaborator—specifically someone who can build or prototype software interfaces, mobile applications, or AI agent systems capable of processing and archiving oral/textual data. Needs a partner experienced in product development or user experience who can help turn a storytelling concept into a functional demo. Also looking for connections to those experienced in podcast production, independent publishing, or building community-centric digital platforms.
